en-AU.promotionalText: On-device Photos storage consultant — find reclaimable space and clean up safely.
en-AU.whatsNew: Similar Media no longer groups different videos from the same event just because they share resolution and length. Only near-copies saved moments apart are listed — extras start selected so Review shows real reclaimable space.
en-AU.description:
DiskWise for iPhone and iPad is an on-device Photos storage consultant. It scans your photo library, estimates reclaimable space, and helps you move clutter to Recently Deleted — never permanent delete in v1.

WHAT IT DOES
• Find exact duplicates and similar media
• Label screenshots on-device with keep scores
• Surface bursts, large videos, and older items
• Ranked recommendations with reclaimable estimates
• Preview and confirm before anything is removed — including one item at a time

SAFE CLEANUP
Selected items go to Photos → Recently Deleted so you can recover them for about 30 days. DiskWise never empties Recently Deleted.

PRIVACY
All analysis runs on your device. Photo contents are not uploaded to a cloud service.

Learn more at https://diskwise.suherman.net

review.notes:
WHAT'S NEW IN 1.0.4
Similar Media only groups near-copies taken moments apart. Same-day event videos that merely share resolution and length are not treated as duplicates. Open Similar Media: extras in each group start selected; Keep this stays on the suggested copy. Confirm items go to Photos → Recently Deleted.

HOW TO REVIEW
1. Tap Continue on the Photos explanation screen, then choose access (Full Access recommended; Limited works).
2. Wait for the library scan — dashboard shows reclaimable space and buckets.
3. Open Similar Media — unrelated event clips should not appear together. If a true near-copy group exists, extras are checked; suggested keep is labeled. Tap Play to preview. Confirm Review shows a non-zero size when extras are selected.
4. Open Screenshots — each row shows a label and keep score. Swipe left to delete one item, or tap View then Delete.
5. Confirm deleted items appear in Photos → Recently Deleted.

No login. Analysis is on-device. DiskWise does not use Location Services.
